expedition: 2021 North Atlantic Stepping Stones: New England and Corner Rise Seamounts
purpose: First exploration of an unexplored and largely unmapped seamount to characterize the biological and geological habitats. This dive was primarily chosen for logistical purposes, but samples and data from here can help inform how the Corner Rise Seamounts, New England Seamounts, and other surrounding seamounts are connected.
